'''''Krayt Dragon Skeleton''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was one of two paintings made by [[Giaal Itotr]] that were put on display at the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]].
